f649b4202a7f108948068527aaf137ebea7e10d1.summary: A Medium post by Michael Koczwara, published 2021-09-15, maps Cobalt Strike command-and-control infrastructure that is possibly attributed to CVE-2021-40444. The author starts from a TrendMicro blog and checks whether the threat actor used other C2 servers on the same hosting provider, subnets and IP ranges. The post names no threat actor, sector, or country.
